ThriftMessageType.authors: `CALL` waits for a reply; `ONEWAY` is fire-and-forget.
ThriftMessageType.implementers: Map to Thrift message type codes (CALL=1, ONEWAY=4).

@thrift__rpc.summary: Binary Thrift RPC field mapping. JSON Thrift uses Connectors `@connect`, not this directive.

authors.intro: Emitted by the Thrift loader in binary mode. Pair with `@transport(kind: "thrift")`.

implementers.runtime: Encode request from `args`, call `function` on `@transport(location:)`, decode with `selection`. Honor `messageType` and `throws`.

subgraph.defaults: Optional locally; loaders usually stamp the subgraph name when composing.
subgraph.constraints: String subgraph name. When present, must match the owning Mesh subgraph / `@transport(subgraph:)` entry used at runtime.
subgraph.authors: Identify which Mesh subgraph owns this annotation when several sources are composed. Omit for single-source hand SDL if the loader will stamp it.
subgraph.implementers: Compose and join rewrites use `subgraph` to attribute directive apps. Transports filter apps by the active subgraph. Never invent a second name for the same source.

service.constraints: Documentation / tooling name; binary executor does not use it for HTTP path (location carries the endpoint).
service.authors: Optional service label on hand SDL.
service.implementers: Do not require for binary path selection.

function.authors: RPC method invoked on the wire.

args.defaults: Optional; omit entirely when the RPC takes no arguments (do not emit empty string).

throws.constraints: Compact IDL throws mapping when errors are modeled.
throws.authors: Map declared exceptions into GraphQL error/union handling.
throws.implementers: Decode exception fields when `ignoreErrorResponses` is false.

messageType.implementers: Set Thrift message type; skip reply decode for ONEWAY.

entity.constraints: When true on a Query field, treat as entity resolver for Mesh `_entities`.
